target_scope.statement: For every exact D003 functional-preorder ideal family F on carrier U, the carrier-relative complement family complementFamilyOn F U is union-closed, nontrivial, and Frankl-abundant.

formal_replay.trust_boundary_scan: clear; no custom axioms, no opaque bypasses

d003_hypothesis_audit.carrier_semantics: U is exactly the ground finset of a FuncSetup datum
d003_hypothesis_audit.family_equality: F is extensionally equal to S.idealFamily
d003_hypothesis_audit.order_ideal_predicate: S.IsOrderIdealOn I requires I ⊆ ground and downward closure under reachability relation Relation.ReflTransGen S.cover
d003_hypothesis_audit.nonempty_carrier: guaranteed by S.nonempty witness in FuncSetup
d003_hypothesis_audit.member_subset_property: every member of F is provably a subset of U

intersection_closure.assessment: Order ideals for a single preorder are closed under binary intersection directly from downward closure; WP06 subset-downward closure (IsIdealFamilyOn) is completely avoided.

complement_union_closure.assessment: De Morgan duality on subsets of fixed carrier U: (U \ S) ∪ (U \ T) = U \ (S ∩ T), transferring intersection closure of F to union closure of complementFamilyOn F U.

cardinality_preservation.assessment: Map S ↦ U \ S is an involution on P(U) (sdiff_sdiff_eq_self_of_subset) and thus strictly injective on F; Finset.card_image_iff guarantees |complementFamilyOn F U| = |F|.

frequency_duality.assessment: Element x ∈ U occurs in complement U \ S if and only if x ∉ S; natural number subtraction |F| - freq(F, x) is exact without truncation error.

double_counting.assessment: Finite bipartite incidence counting (sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow) independently establishes ∑_{S ∈ F} |S| = ∑_{x ∈ U} freq(F, x).

rare_element_extraction.assessment: D004 average rarity (2 * ∑ |S| ≤ |U| * |F|) together with carrier nonemptiness guarantees existence of x ∈ U with 2 * freq(F, x) ≤ |F| by contradiction on summing strict inequalities.

abundance_transfer.assessment: Duality 2 * (|F| - freq(F, x)) ≥ |F| yields 2 * freq(F', x) ≥ |F'|; support membership x ∈ support(F') is witnessed by U = U \ ∅ ∈ F' since ∅ ∈ F.

nontriviality.assessment: IsNontrivial is defined as (support F').Nonempty and is directly witnessed by the abundant support element x.

companion_theorem_assessment.assessment: Average rarity 2 * ∑ |S| ≤ |U| * |F| dualizes to average abundance |U| * |F| ≤ 2 * ∑ |U \ S| using exact integer subtraction in complementFamilyOn_averageAbundant_of_averageRare.

representation_firewall.assessment: IsComplementOfFunctionalPreorderIdealFamily and complementOfFunctionalPreorderIdealFamily_frankl are one-way restricted wrappers. No converse or universal representation theorem exists. UC-P04 remains OPEN, and UC-FRANKL remains an OPEN_PROBLEM.

adversarial_checks.smallest_admissible_carrier: PASS: |U|=1, U={1}, F={∅,{1}}, F'={{1},∅}=F, freq=1, card=2, abundant, nontrivial.
adversarial_checks.total_chain_preorder: PASS: Chain 1 ≤ 2 ≤ ... ≤ n, ideals are initial segments, complements are final segments, strictly union-closed, element n abundant in n of n+1 sets.
adversarial_checks.discrete_preorder: PASS: f=id, every subset is an order ideal, F=P(U), F'=P(U), elements have frequency 2^(n-1) = |F|/2, abundance holds with exact equality.
adversarial_checks.equivalence_classes_preorder: PASS: Cycles/SCCs condense to single components, ideals respect equivalence classes, duality and abundance are preserved.
adversarial_checks.minimum_order_ideals: PASS: F={∅,U}, F'={U,∅}, support=U, each element occurs in 1 of 2 sets, 2*1 ≥ 2, abundant.
adversarial_checks.half_frequency_boundary: PASS: Exact half frequency 2*freq = card satisfies nonstrict inequality 2*freq ≥ card in IsFranklAbundant.
adversarial_checks.duplicate_complement_invariance: PASS: S ↦ U \ S is an involution on P(U), Finset.image preserves cardinality exactly without collapse.
adversarial_checks.singleton_carrier_support: PASS: |U|=1 yields support {x} which is nonempty, satisfying IsNontrivial without vacuity.

qualifications: The certification is strictly restricted to families that are carrier-relative complements of exact D003 functional-preorder ideal families on nonempty finite ground sets.
This certification does not establish representation of arbitrary finite union-closed families by complements of functional-preorder ideal families.
Frankl's union-closed sets conjecture (UC-FRANKL) remains an OPEN_PROBLEM.
Predecessor certificate MC-UC-WP04-QUAL-001 remains immutable predecessor authority.
Preorder-downward closure does not imply WP06 subset-downward closure (IsIdealFamilyOn), which fails on the 3-chain fixture.

provenance.independence_statement: Substantively independent certifier evaluation; certifier did not participate in WP07-D005 proof construction or verification in MATHSOLVE.

claim_boundary: This adjudication certifies only the exact restricted UC-WP07-P006 theorem under its recorded qualifications. It does not establish representation of arbitrary union-closed families, does not close UC-P04, does not prove Frankl's conjecture (UC-FRANKL), does not mutate predecessor certificate MC-UC-WP04-QUAL-001, and authorizes no novelty, priority, publication, patentability, product, or commercial claims.
